docs: Ejected from @macaw-ds/icons@0.2.1. Icons next to visible text are decorative: do not pass label. An icon that is the only content of a control needs a label, or the control needs aria-label.

manifest.name: Icon
manifest.purpose: Renders one icon from the curated set, bound to size and tone tokens. Not for logos or illustrations.
manifest.description: A thin wrapper over a curated Lucide subset. Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass `label` when the icon carries meaning on its own. The set is deliberately small: adding an icon is a PR with a screenshot of where it is used.

size.description: 14, 16, 20 or 24 px. md matches body text; sm matches label-sm.

tone.description: Colour. inherit takes the surrounding text colour, which is right inside buttons and text.

label.description: Accessible name. Only when the icon is the sole content; otherwise leave empty so it stays decorative.
label.a11y: Sets role=img and aria-label; without it the icon is aria-hidden.

a11y.role: img when label is set; otherwise none (aria-hidden)
a11y.name: From the label prop. Decorative icons have no name and are hidden from assistive technology.
notes: Never rely on an icon alone to convey status; pair it with text or a Badge.
Status tones meet 3:1 against surface.default in both themes.

rules: Icons next to visible text are decorative: do not pass label.
An icon that is the only content of a control needs a label, or the control needs aria-label.
Use tone="inherit" inside buttons and text so the icon follows the text colour.
dos: Use size="sm" inside label-sm text and size="md" inside body text.
donts: Do not import from lucide-react directly in a consumer; the curated set is the contract.
Do not use icons for logos or illustrations.
